metadata.title: About and Resume — Leonardo Vitale
metadata.description: Profile, accomplishments, experience, education and front-end expertise.

title: Front-end leadership grounded in interface craft
profile: I am a front-end engineer and technical leader with more than 20 years across interface design, UX, product development and enterprise front-end architecture. I moved from rich web and connected-TV platforms into React in 2015, then specialized in scaling front-end systems and teams.

accomplishments.architecture: Led adoption of Clean Architecture across multiple front-end squads.
accomplishments.onboarding: Reduced onboarding time by approximately 30% through architecture standardization.
accomplishments.standards: Defined controller-hook, DTO-boundary, folder-structure and testing standards.
accomplishments.quality: Strengthened front-end quality gates and release stability.

achievements.architecture: Leads front-end architecture, delivery quality and technical strategy across squads.
achievements.team: Leads a team of six front-end engineers while remaining hands-on in critical React and TypeScript paths.
achievements.standards: Drove Clean Architecture, SOLID and shared engineering standards.

achievements.platform: Enhanced an indoor-cycling platform using Angular, REST APIs and custom UI solutions.

achievements.products: Built international automotive products with React, TypeScript and Styled Components.

achievements.modernization: Led front-end modernization for Nationwide Building Society with React and Redux.

achievements.xbox: Designed VOD experiences for the Xbox One generation.
achievements.react: Adopted React in 2015 and helped teach it across the team.
achievements.netNow: Led UX and front-end work for NET NOW, including the player experience.
